description: There is no Deny or Cancel control on the approval page. A user who does not recognise the request can only close the tab; the request stays pending (Waiting for approval...) and approvable by anyone who knows the verification code until it expires after 10 minutes. The API has a deny route, but no UI calls it.
expected: A visible 'Deny' / 'This is not mine' button.
actual: Only 'Approve agent'; instructions in small grey text say to close the page.
suggested_fix: Add a secondary Deny button that calls the existing deny route.

description: The Agents page in the console does not list pending pairing requests, so there is no place to review or cancel one after closing the page.
expected: Pending requests visible with a cancel action.
actual: '0 AGENTS / Create your first agent' with a pending request outstanding.

description: The Agents empty state offers 'Create your first agent' (manual identity then API key) beside 'Connect an agent'. For a first-time user the two routes compete; the Connect panel copy says 'open it and click Approve' and omits the verification code that the page then requires.
expected: One primary route; copy that matches the page.
